## Necrophage Carrier, Gray Monstrosity (Augmented Gray Render) (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
NE Large aberration  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 28, touch 11, flat-footed 26 (+2 Dex, +17 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 204 (12d8+108) fast healing 4  
**Fort** +13, Ref +6, Will +10  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 5/-, from the void regrow limbs (see above)  
**Immune** cold, disease, mind-affecting effects, poison  
**Weaknesses** limb weakness  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., Climb 10 ft.  
**Melee** 2 scythe claws +19 (2d6+10/x3), bite +18 (2d6+10), 2 claws +18 (1d8+10 plus grab  


**Statistics**


**Str** 31, **Dex** 15, **Con** 28, **Int** -, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 4  
**Base Attack** +9; **CMB** +20 (+24 grapple); **CMD** 32  
**Feats** Weapon Focus (scythe claw)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** Any, dark tapestry  
**Organization** solitary, pair or with necrophage carrier  
**Treasure** none  


**Special Abilities**


**Limb Weakness (Ex)** If the necrophage is subject to a critical hit, it loses a limb, the limb lost can be randomly determined or chosen by the GM. If it loses a leg, it could cause the creature to become prone or if an attacking limb is severed, it loses a natural attack.
